notes: Plan 7 Track I added a `foe` (who a Fight on the line is against) to wolves-and-goats, nothing else. Designer call 2026-11-14: every wound here was tripled (written for 3e HP; 5e has about 3–4× more). The prototype's six events (src/lib/data.ts at tag v0.1.0-svelte-final), ported as faithfully as possible. The first two were handwritten by the designer; the last four were generated with ChatGPT for the prototype. Each entry's notes list its prototype participants and secret, how prose odds became checks, and any additions. Plan 3 added metadata only, text unchanged: a disposition (hostile, neutral or pleasant) on each event, for travel pace.

entries.title: Fishermen at the pond
entries.notes: Prototype event 1, handwritten. Participants: 4 human commoners (level 3). Secret: one of them carries an amulet that improves foraging. Conversions: Steal's d20 thresholds (10 / 15 / 20 / above) became Sleight of Hand DC 16, and Fight (combat) became the 'brawl' stage with a graded combat check. Additions: Approach heals 2 HP as a stand-in for food and ale until goods exist (Plan 4); 'Back off' lets you pay your way out of the brawl; the amulet is a log line until items exist.

start.text: A group of fishermen are sitting by a small pond, fishing, drinking ale and laughing at each other's jokes.

options.label: Approach
options.description: Approach the fishermen calmly and join their group.

outcome.text: They make room by the water and share their food and ale.

options.label: Steal
options.description: Try to make off with their valuables while they are distracted.

fail.text: The fishermen noticed you and prepare for battle!

partial.text: The fishermen noticed you and secured their belongings.

success.text: You were able to steal their wallets, containing 4 gp in total.

critSuccess.text: You were able to pickpocket one of the fishermen. Gained an Amulet of Foraging!

effects.text: Amulet of Foraging (items arrive in a later plan).

options.label: Fight
options.description: Initiate combat.

outcome.text: You stride towards them with weapons drawn. The laughter stops.

options.label: Ignore
options.description: Let them continue in peace.

brawl.text: Four fishermen get to their feet with gutting knives and oars.

fail.text: Oars and fists. You win in the end, but it hurts.

partial.text: They break and run, but not before {actor} takes an oar to the head.

success.text: They scatter, leaving their wallets behind.

options.label: Back off
options.description: Pay for the insult and leave.

outcome.text: You toss them a few coins for the trouble and back away.

entries.title: The unburnt grove
entries.notes: Prototype event 2, handwritten. Secret: the trees are imbued with magic that protects them from fire, left by an ancient ritual at a meeting place of high elves. Conversions: the INT check became Arcana DC 12, with the prototype's two results as the partial and success tiers; a critical success reveals the secret. Changes: Investigate and Arcana can each be tried once before you decide; 'inflammable' became 'fireproof' (the prototype meant the opposite); the bark is a log line until items exist.

start.text: You pass through a barren section of forest that was damaged about a decade ago by a forest fire. In the middle of the desolation, you find a circle of trees that seems untouched by the fire that destroyed the surroundings.

options.label: Investigate the trees
options.description: See if the trees have anything special about them.

outcome.text: You notice that some of the trees are warm to the touch, but don't have other special characteristics.

options.label: Use arcana knowledge
options.description: Try to find clues related to the use of magic.

fail.text: Whatever is here, {actor} can't make sense of it.

partial.text: You notice that the trees are protected against fire.

success.text: You notice that some sort of ritual or enchantment has been placed around the area a long time ago.

critSuccess.text: {actor} recognises the old craft: high elves met here once, and their ritual still guards the trees from fire.

options.label: Burn the trees
options.description: Try to set a fire to the remaining trees.

outcome.text: The fire has trouble catching onto the trees. It's as if the trees are entirely fireproof.

options.label: Rip bark from the trees
options.description: Take a piece of bark with you for future use.

outcome.text: You gained a piece of bark. What are you going to do with it?

effects.text: Fireproof bark (items arrive in a later plan).

options.label: Ignore
options.description: Ignore the trees.

outcome.text: You ignore the trees and decide to go somewhere else.

entries.title: The abandoned dwarven mine
entries.notes: Prototype event 3, generated with ChatGPT for the prototype. Hidden participants: 2 dwarf fighters (level 5) and a human rogue (level 4), unused here as there. Secret: a hidden, heavily trapped passage leads to a treasure room. Conversions: Explore's two results became Investigation DC 13 (finding the map on a success); 'Search for the treasure room' needs the map, so it moved to a second stage as Perception DC 14 against the traps. Additions: a critical failure while exploring brings down rubble; trap damage on the search; the warhammer is a log line until items exist.

start.text: The group stumbles upon an abandoned dwarven mine. It's filled with rubble and looks like it hasn't been used in decades.

options.label: Explore the mine
options.description: Investigate the abandoned dwarven mine.

critFail.text: A rotten prop gives way, and rubble comes down on {actor}.

fail.text: The party finds nothing out of the ordinary, just rubble and old equipment scattered throughout the mine.

partial.text: The party finds nothing out of the ordinary, just rubble and old equipment scattered throughout the mine.

success.text: The party finds a map that shows the location of a hidden treasure room!

options.label: Leave the mine
options.description: Abandon the mine and move on.

map.text: The map shows a hidden passage behind a collapsed gallery. Scratched beside it, in old dwarvish: 'mind the floor'.

options.label: Search for the treasure room
options.description: Use the map to find the treasure room.

critFail.text: {actor} misses the pressure plate. Darts hiss out of the walls.

fail.text: A trap springs on {actor}, and you retreat bleeding and empty-handed.

partial.text: You reach the treasure room past one trap too many. There is still gold in the chest.

success.text: The party finds the hidden passage and successfully navigates through the traps to the treasure room. They find a chest filled with gold and gems.

critSuccess.text: The party finds the hidden passage and successfully navigates through the traps to the treasure room. They find a chest filled with gold and gems, as well as a magical dwarven warhammer.

effects.text: Magical dwarven warhammer (items arrive in a later plan).

options.label: Leave the mine
options.description: Abandon the mine and move on.

entries.title: The lizardfolk ritual
entries.notes: Prototype event 4, generated with ChatGPT for the prototype. Participants: a half-elf bard and a human wizard (level 3), unused. Secret: the sacrifice is a powerful artifact the lizardfolk have guarded for generations, said to control the weather and bring fortune. Conversions: Steal's prose odds (30% unseen, 50% detected and fighting out, 20% an elemental) became Stealth DC 16: success unseen, fail and partial fight their way out, a critical failure summons the elemental. Additions: the trade's herb quest is the follow-up 'lizardfolk-herb' (data/claude); the artifact is a log line until items exist.

start.text: The party encounters a group of lizardfolk who are performing a ritual. They're gathered around a large stone altar and seem to be offering a sacrifice to their deity.

options.label: Approach the lizardfolk
options.description: Attempt to communicate with the lizardfolk and learn more about their ritual.

outcome.text: The party is able to communicate with the lizardfolk and learn more about their culture and traditions. However, they are unable to learn anything about the artifact.

options.label: Steal the artifact
options.description: Attempt to steal the artifact while the lizardfolk are distracted.

critFail.text: The lizardfolk call upon their deity and a powerful elemental is summoned to defend the artifact.

fail.text: The party is detected and must fight their way out.

partial.text: The party is detected at the last moment and fights its way out.

success.text: The party is able to steal the artifact without being detected.

effects.text: Weather-calling artifact (items arrive in a later plan).

options.label: Trade for the artifact
options.description: Attempt to negotiate with the lizardfolk for the artifact.

outcome.text: The lizardfolk are willing to trade the artifact for a rare magical herb that grows in the nearby jungle. The party must find the herb and return it to the lizardfolk in exchange for the artifact.

options.label: Leave the lizardfolk alone
options.description: Ignore the lizardfolk and move on.

entries.title: Wolves on the mountain path
entries.notes: Prototype event 5, generated with ChatGPT for the prototype. Participant: a half-elf ranger (level 5), unused. Secret: the alpha wolf wears an enchanted collar that only a special key removes (shown on a critical success). Conversions: Fight (50% win, 30% win with losses, 20% lose) became a combat Athletics check at DC 12; Sneak (70% / 30%) Stealth DC 10; Save the wolves (the wolves turn on you, then 70% / 30%) a combat Athletics check at DC 10 where every result costs HP. 'Lose some party members' became heavy HP loss: encounters don't kill outright until the run loop exists (Plan 5).

start.text: As you climb the mountain, you come across a narrow, treacherous path. Suddenly, a group of mountain goats cross your path, but they are being chased by a pack of wolves.

options.label: Fight the wolves
options.description: Attack the wolves and try to save the goats.

fail.text: You lose the fight and scramble back down the path.

partial.text: You save the goats, but the wolves maul {actor} before they break.

success.text: You defeat the wolves and save the goats.

critSuccess.text: You defeat the wolves and save the goats. The alpha wears an enchanted collar with a strange keyhole.

effects.text: The alpha's collar needs a special key to remove.

options.label: Sneak past the wolves
options.description: Try to sneak past the wolves and continue on your journey.

partial.text: The wolves notice you at the last moment and snap at your heels as you go.

success.text: You sneak past the wolves and continue on your journey.

options.label: Save the wolves
options.description: Attempt to drive the goats away to protect the wolves.

fail.text: The wolves become aggressive and attack the party, losing the goats. You lose the fight.

partial.text: The wolves become aggressive and attack the party, losing the goats. You beat them off, bloodied.

success.text: The wolves become aggressive and attack the party, losing the goats. You defeat the wolves.

entries.title: The pit in the cave
entries.notes: Prototype event 6, generated with ChatGPT for the prototype. Participant: a dwarf fighter (level 4), unused. Secret: the pit is a trap with spikes at the bottom. Conversions: Investigate became Perception DC 10, tried once, whose success grants Edge for the jump; Jump (50% / 50%) Athletics DC 12; 'Find a way around' leads to the goblins (50% / 50%), a combat check at DC 12. Addition: you can back away from the goblins at the cost of a day.

start.text: You enter a dark cave and are greeted by the sound of dripping water. You notice a deep pit in the ground that is barely visible in the darkness.

options.label: Investigate the pit
options.description: Approach and investigate the pit.

critFail.text: {actor} leans too far over the edge and catches a spike climbing back.

fail.text: It's too dark to see the bottom.

partial.text: You spot the spikes at the bottom and realize that it is a trap, likely set up by goblins or other creatures. Beware.

success.text: You spot the spikes at the bottom and realize that it is a trap, likely set up by goblins or other creatures. Beware. {actor} also finds the best place to jump.

options.label: Jump over the pit
options.description: Attempt to jump over the pit.

fail.text: You fail to jump and fall into the spikes, taking damage.

partial.text: You make the jump, barely, and scrape a shin on the far edge.

success.text: You successfully jump over the pit.

options.label: Find a way around the pit
options.description: Try to find a different way around the pit.

outcome.text: You manage to find a path that leads around the pit, avoiding the trap. However, you also find a group of goblins waiting for you.

goblins.text: Goblins crouch in the side passage, blades out, grinning.

fail.text: You lose the fight and are driven back out of the cave.

outcome.text: You back out of the cave and take the long way round.
